title: Twenty years, ii
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Tuesday, September 12. Twenty. The corn. The garage. The pup. #1 on the wall — and today, beside it, the Timberline's new back page, which the kid gave him yesterday. Two first strips, twenty years apart.

panels.composition: The garage. Corn. WOOD. BARNABY II in the bed. On the wall: #1, yellowed, and beside it a fresh newsprint back page — the napkin kid's first strip in the Timberline.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man at a drafting table with a tray of corn, a small three-legged dog in a bed, a yellowed old strip and a fresh newsprint page pinned side by side on the wall
image.notes: Two back pages: Sept 12, 1997 and Sept 2017. The kid's strip is reserved in content; draw it as a four-panel shape.

panels.composition: The two pages, close. The same masthead: THE TIMBERLINE. Twenty years of newsprint between them; the font the same.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of two newspaper back pages pinned side by side with the same masthead, one yellowed and one fresh
image.notes: Letter after: THE TIMBERLINE on both.

balloons.text: Twenty years. He's got the back page. He's got the corn. He's got a girl who proofs the drawing and not the text.
I didn't tell him about the drawing part. Somebody should've told me.
